uncited: **Inputs:** viewport width $W$, height $H$, FOV $\theta_{fov}$ (degrees), near plane $n$, far plane $f$, eye position $E$, target $T$, up vector $U$.
**Outputs:** view matrix $V$, projection matrix $P$, view-projection matrix $VP$, inverse view-projection $VP^{-1}$, `CameraUniform` struct.
**Compute FOV Tangents:** Convert FOV to radians $\theta_{rad} = \text{radians}(\theta_{fov})$.
This method is fundamental to computer graphics, originating from standard perspective projection and look-at camera models.
